settings.label: Rumble Strength
settings.help: Controls the strength of rumble when using a controller that supports it. Setting this to zero will disable rumble.

settings.label: Gyro Sensitivity
settings.help: Controls the sensitivity of gyro aiming when using items in first person for controllers that support it. Setting this to zero will disable gyro. Note: To recalibrate controller gyro, set the controller down on a still, flat surface for 5 seconds.

settings.label: Mouse Sensitivity
settings.help: How far the mouse turns Joanna. At 50% a count turns her 0.055 degrees, as the Perfect Dark PC port's default does, less when zoomed. 0% is the original game: no mouse, and the pointer stays free. Left click fires and right click aims (Z and R): aiming shows the crosshair and zooms the weapons that zoom, and she walks, strafes and turns as she does without it, the mouse turning her. The wheel changes weapon, or zooms the sniper rifle while aiming. The game's Look Ahead is off while the mouse plays. E or R (B) uses what is in front of her, a door or a console, and reloads otherwise; held, it changes the gun's function. Left Shift aims too, and C crouches, or stands her back up.

settings.label: Joystick Deadzone
settings.help: Applies a deadzone to joystick inputs.

settings.label: Background Input Mode
settings.help: Allows the game to read controller input when out of focus. This setting does not affect keyboard input.

settings.label: Invert Mouse Y
settings.help: Moving the mouse up looks down.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: Sets the output resolution of the game. Original matches the game's original 240p resolution. Original 2x will render at 480p. Auto will scale based on the game window's resolution.

settings.label: Downsampling Quality
settings.help: Renders at a higher resolution and scales it down to the output resolution for increased quality. Only available in Original and Original 2x resolution. Note: 4x downsampling quality at Original 2x resolution may cause performance issues on low end devices, as it will cause the game to render at almost 4k internal resolution.

settings.label: Aspect Ratio
settings.help: Sets the horizontal aspect ratio. Original uses the game's original 4:3 aspect ratio. Expand will adjust to match the game window's aspect ratio.

settings.label: Window Mode
settings.help: Sets whether the game should display Windowed or Fullscreen. You can also use F11 or Alt + Enter to toggle this option.

settings.label: Framerate
settings.help: Sets the game's output framerate. This option does not affect gameplay. Note: If you have issues with Display mode while using an external frame limiter, use Manual mode instead and configure it to that same frame limit.

settings.label: Manual Framerate
settings.help: The framerate Manual draws the game at. This option does not affect gameplay.

settings.label: MS Anti-Aliasing
settings.help: Sets the multisample anti-aliasing (MSAA) quality level. This reduces jagged edges in the final image at the expense of rendering performance. Note: This option won't be available if your GPU does not support programmable MSAA sample positions, as it is currently required to avoid rendering glitches.

settings.label: HUD Placement
settings.help: Adjusts the placement of HUD elements to fit the selected aspect ratio. Expand will use the aspect ratio of the game's output window.

settings.label: Field of View
settings.help: How much of the level Joanna sees, from the top of the screen to the bottom. The game shows 60 degrees; a wider angle shows more around her, and the zoom of a gun or the Farsight magnifies as much as ever. Cutscenes and the menus keep the game's angle. Aspect Ratio's Expand already widens the view to the sides.

settings.label: Main Volume
settings.help: Controls the main volume of the game.
